128    /**
129     * Generate a country calling code prefix.
130     *
131     * @example Prefix an empty string: ''
132     * @example Prefix the country calling code: '+30'
133     *
134     * @internal Used to generate phone numbers with or without prefixes.
135     *
136     * @return string
137     */
138    public static function internationalCodePrefix()
139    {
140        return static::randomElement(static::$internationalCallPrefixes);
141    }
142
143    /**
144     * Generate an area code for a fixed line number.
145     *
146     * Doesn't include codes for Greater Athens Metropolitan Area (21#) because
147     * this zone uses 3 digits, and phone numbers have a different formatting.
148     *
149     * Area codes in all the other zones use 4 digits.
150     * The capital of each zone uses 3 digits and the 4th digit can be any number.
151     * The other areas in each zone use 4 digits, but not every number is valid for the 4th digit.
152     *
153     * @example Thessaloniki has code '231', so '2310' and '2313' are valid.
154     * @example Serres has code '232', but '2326', '2328' and '2329' are not valid.
155     *
156     * @return string
157     */
158    public static function areaCode()
159    {
160        return static::numerify(
161            str_pad(static::randomElement(static::$areaCodes), 4, '#'),
162        );
163    }
164
165    /**
166     * Generate a fixed line number.
167     *
168     * Numbers can be generated with or without the international code prefix.
169     * Numbers can be generated with or without spaces between their parts.
170     * Numbers in Athens use a 3-digit area code, and can be formatted as 21# ### ####.
171     * Numbers in other areas use a 4-digit area code, and can be formatted as 2### ### ###.
172     *
173     * @example A number in Athens: '2101234567'
174     * @example A number in Thessaloniki: '2310123456'
175     * @example A number with spaces in Athens: '210 123 4567'
176     * @example A number with spaces in Thessaloniki: '2310 123 456'
177     * @example A number with international code prefix: '+302101234567'
178     * @example A number with international code prefix and spaces: '+30 2310 123 456'
179     *
180     * @return string
181     */
182    public function fixedLineNumber()
183    {
184        return ltrim(static::numerify($this->generator->parse(
185            static::randomElement(static::$fixedLineFormats),
186        )));
187    }
188
